Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick onboarding walkthrough? Downloaded the benchmark report

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the benchmark report you published last week — I grabbed the Brightlane-specific export and skimmed the latency/cost charts. Our infra lead asked for a short walkthrough so we can see how Redwood would behave against our 300–500 token tail workloads.

Would love a 25–30 minute demo where someone can show:
- how batching and prefix caching work in practice
- expected p50/p95 on an 8k-context model for our request shape
- a quick note on Dedicated vs Hosted economics for steady throughput

I'm on Pacific time (PDT) and free:
- Tue 4/20: 1:00–2:00pm or 4:00–5:00pm
- Wed 4/21: 10:00–11:00am
If those don't work I can be flexible next week — happy to send a calendar invite.

Attaching the annotated benchmark we exported (brightlane-benchmark-notes.pdf) — some internal notes in page comments.

Best,
Olivia
Head of Platform Engineering
Brightlane, Inc.

Attachments: brightlane-benchmark-notes.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)
